fullContent:
Lavangadi Churna 
 Reference: Bhaishajya Ratnavali Striroga Adhikara 
 INTRODUCTION 
 Lavangadi Churna is in a powdered form which is made from cloves along with other herbs and is used to treat diarrhea, abdominal pain, bloating, gastritis etc. 
 INGREDIENTS 
 
 Lavanga / Clove ( Syzygium aromaticum ) 
 Tankan Bhasma (Borax) 
 Musta / Nut grass ( Cyperus rotundus ) 
 Dhataki / Fire flame bush ( Woodfordia fruticosa ) 
 Bilva / Bael ( Aegle marmelos ) 
 Dhanyaka / Coriander ( Coriandrum sativum ) 
 Copal Tree ( Vateria indica ) 
 Nutmeg ( Myristica fragrans ) 
 Indian dill ( Peucedanum graveolens ) 
 Cumin ( Cuminum cyminum ) 
 Saindhav (Rock Salt) 
 Mocharasa ( Bombax malabaricum ) 
 Utpala ( Nymphaea stellate ) 
 Rasanjana ( Berberis aristata ) 
 Abhraka Bhasma (Calcined formation of Mica) 
 Vanga Bhasma (Calcined formation of Tin) 
 Lajjalu/Touch me not ( Mimosa pudica ) 
 Red Sandalwood ( Pterocarpus santalinus ) 
 Chavya ( Piper retrofractum ) 
 Ativisha ( Aconitum heterophyllum ) 
 Shringi ( Citrulus colocynthis ) 
 Khadira / heart wood ( Acacia catechu ) 
 Balaka ( Pavonia odorata ) 
 Bhringaraja ( Eclipta alba ) 
 
 METHOD OF PREPARATION 
 Clean and grind these ingredients to form a fine powder mix them together later in the required and specified amount and store them in an air tight container away from from heat and light. 
 DOSAGE 
 3 grams to 6 grams along with honey twice daily as prescribed by your doctor. 
 INDICATIONS 
 
 Cough 
 Anorexia 
 Vomiting 
 Weak digestion 
 Diarrhea 
 Rhinitis 
 Abdominal lump 
 Constipation 
 Impotency 
 Malabsorption syndrome 
 
 CONTRAINDICATIONS 
 
 Over-dosage should be avoided as it may cause constipation. 
 Diabetic patients should use it under strict medical advice as it contains sugar. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
